watchOut: The Wyvern status is its own statement with a link we did not follow.
name: PrivateJet.com
roleBasis: Its homepage refers to "our private jet charter broker Wilbur AI" and links a Wyvern verification, describing itself as a "WYVERN Registered Broker".
summary: Broker site with quote forms by trip type and an AI assistant, and no published price.
differentiator: Separates quote requests by trip type: business, group, sports team, hospitality, leisure and air ambulance. No hourly rate or sample price is published on the homepage.
priceNote: The homepage shows quote request links and no dollar figure for charter.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers whose trip fits one of its trip-type forms, such as a group or sports team charter.
skipIf: You want any published price before you ask.
